_comment: e-puck 1 twin. world, epuck, sensors, floor and the food values of task copied from easabrain_config.json (themselves from easagru, commit 2c3191d); Khepera, camera, vision and perturbation sections dropped. The control rate here is set by epuck-remote (--hz), not by sensors.control_period_steps.

body_led._comment: Body LED led8 (the visual signal), measured from the EPUCK_BODY_LED mesh in E-puck.proto: only two arcs (front and rear; the wheels take the sides). Angles in the robot frame, x forward, y left.

ir_rays._comment: IR rays per e-puck sensor (Webots DistanceSensor numberOfRays). aperture from E-puckDistanceSensor.proto; gaussian_width is the Webots default (1). easabrain uses 5 (needed there to see the low Khepera II body); kept as default.

sensors._comment: as easagru: control every 8 physics steps (66.7 ms); sensor noise on (Webots lookup-table noise)
